name: Wmns Air Jordan 11 Retro Low 'Legend Pink'
story_html: The Women's Air Jordan 11 Retro Low 'Legend Pink' brings a white ballistic mesh upper with tonal webbing eyelets and a pink patent leather mudguard to the iconic silhouette. The sneaker is mounted on a lightweight Phylon midsole with full-length Air cushioning. Underfoot, a pink translucent rubber outsole features herringbone traction pods for superior grip, along with a carbon fiber shank plate for midfoot stability.
